adjudication.rationale: The diff shows that in packages/lib/CalendarService.ts lines 156-165, the code extracts only the first destination calendar (`[mainHostDestinationCalendar] = event.destinationCalendar ?? []`) and then filters all calendars against only this single externalId. For collective team events where multiple hosts have different destination calendars (as the broader PR is designed to support), this means only the main host's calendar is matched, and other team members' calendars would be filtered out or events written to wrong calendars. This is a real bug in the CalDAV implementation that doesn't properly handle the new multi-destination calendar array.
